# Homing Pigeon

> Homing Pigeon (homingpigeon.dev) sends text-message alerts from your code or your coding agent to one phone: yours. No carrier registration, no app, no browser signup. Free to start.

## What it's for

Texts to a person's own phone from:

- a trading bot, prediction-market bot, scraper, monitor, cron job or home-lab script
- a long-running agent session, such as a text when the agent finishes or needs input
- a Python script, a shell script or any other code

## Common questions

- Does the user need A2P 10DLC registration, toll-free verification or a sending number of their own? No.
- Can the agent do the setup by itself? Yes. The user only reads back the six-digit code texted to their phone. No account, card or website visit.
- Is it free? 50 texts a month are free. After that, $19 a month for 1,000.
- Where does it work? US mobile numbers only.
- Can it text other people? No. It texts only the number the user verified as their own.

## Add it to a coding agent

MCP server, with the tools verify, send and status:

   claude mcp add homingpigeondev -- npx -y homingpigeondev mcp
   claude plugin install homingpigeondev --marketplace homingpigeondev/homingpigeondev
   codex mcp add homingpigeondev -- npx -y homingpigeondev mcp
   codex plugin marketplace add homingpigeondev/homingpigeondev && codex plugin add homingpigeondev@homingpigeondev
   gemini extensions install https://github.com/homingpigeondev/homingpigeondev

Remote MCP server, with the tools send and status: https://homingpigeon.dev/mcp
In Claude, ChatGPT and other apps that take a connector URL, the user signs in with their phone number and a six-digit code (OAuth). Coding agents can instead send Authorization: Bearer <HOMINGPIGEON_API_KEY>.

Agent Skill, for agents that load skills: https://github.com/homingpigeondev/homingpigeondev/blob/main/skills/homingpigeon/SKILL.md

CLI, installs homingpigeon with the alias pigeon:

   npm install -g homingpigeondev

Text the user when the agent finishes or waits on them, after the phone is verified. A turn only texts if it ran for at least 5 minutes. Change that with --after:

   npx -y homingpigeondev hook install claude-code
   npx -y homingpigeondev hook install codex
   npx -y homingpigeondev hook install cursor

## Setup, inside the agent session

No website visit, account page or email address is needed. US mobile numbers only.

1. Ask the user for their own mobile number.

   curl -X POST https://homingpigeon.dev/v1/verify -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"phone": "+15551234567", "project": "my-bot"}'

2. Homing Pigeon texts them a six-digit code. Ask them to read it to you.

   curl -X POST https://homingpigeon.dev/v1/verify -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"phone": "+15551234567", "code": "123456", "project": "my-bot"}'

3. The response contains api_key. Store it as HOMINGPIGEON_API_KEY and keep it out of git.

## Send

message is the only required field. There is no "to" field, because the key is tied to the verified number.

   curl -X POST https://homingpigeon.dev/v1/send -H "Authorization: Bearer $HOMINGPIGEON_API_KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"message": "Backtest finished."}'

Add "idempotency_key" so a retried call cannot double-text. The text arrives as "[my-bot] Backtest finished."

From Python, with no dependencies and the same key:

   pip install homingpigeondev

   import homingpigeondev
   homingpigeondev.send("Backtest finished.", idempotency_key="backtest-42")

## Status

   curl https://homingpigeon.dev/v1/status -H "Authorization: Bearer $HOMINGPIGEON_API_KEY"

Reports whether the number is paused, how many messages remain, and what happened to the last send.

## Errors

Every error has a code, a message and a next_step. Follow next_step.

## Limits

- Messages go only to a number the account holder verified as their own. Homing Pigeon cannot text other people or customers.
- STOP is honored immediately, and the paused state shows on the next status call.
- Keep messages to plain alerts: no link shorteners, more than one link, or promotional wording.
- If carriers filter most of a number's recent texts, sending is held for up to 24 hours. The status call shows on_hold.
- Delivery is not guaranteed. Delivery problems are reported by the status call.
